messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Hosted API region=us-west - request_queue_depth=7200, GPU_pool_util=98%, p95=4.2s, p99=18.6s. Autoscaler errors: provisioner_timeout x12. Triggering pager. <https://ops.internal/incidents/1779311111|details>
oncall-sre: taking pager. looking at autoscaler logs now. seeing repeated CreateInstance failures with API quota errors from cloud provider.
infra-lead: confirmed quota errors + slow instance boot times. ETA on manual capacity increase is ~10-15m but need landlord approval for extra vCPU quota in this account.
junior-eng: a subset of traffic is very bursty (marketing campaign). can we temporarily route low-priority customers to fallback model to free GPU slots? we have redwood-compact-1 available in eu-west.
platform-pm: good call. impact: some enterprise customers (alpha-analytics, paybeam) reporting 504/timeouts. CS @customer-success is triaging customer tickets.
customer-success: alpha-analytics: multiple 504s, elevated support priority. paybeam: degraded p95 on embeddings API, non-blocking but noisy.
oncall-sre: attempting fast mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing for free-tier and trial accounts, 2) evict long-running batch jobs in hosted-us-west low-priority pool, 3) open emergency quota request with cloud console.
oncall-sre: applying throttles -> `route update --match tier:free --rate-limit 30r/m`  (will reduce incoming burst).
junior-eng: evicting low-priority batches now: `orchestrator evict --pool hosted-us-west --label batch=true --dry-run=false` - started.
infra-lead: manual pool expansion blocked until quota request approved. provisioning retries are failing fast; logs show OCI API 429 on CreateInstance.
platform-pm: approve fallback model plan. create a temporary routing rule: if queue_depth > 2000 route to redwood-compact-1 (best-effort) and mark requests with `x-fallback: true`.
oncall-sre: applied routing rule. see immediate queue drain in request gauge (small dip). p95 down to 2.1s, p99 falling from 18s to 9.4s.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation=partial; state=investigating; impact=customer_timeouts; pages=oncall-sre. Ops link: https://ops.internal/incidents/1779311111
customer-success: notifying top 5 impacted customers now. drafting status note: "We experienced elevated request latencies and intermittent timeouts due to capacity constraints; mitigation in progress; follow-up will include postmortem and quota remediation plan."
infra-lead: cloud quota increased request submitted, case #CLOUD-8921. support response ETA ~20m. if they approve, we can spin up +12 instances and drain queue fully.
oncall-sre: if cloud doesn't approve quickly, plan B is to enable additional fallback across all paid tiers (degrades quality but reduces load). need sign-off from PM.
platform-pm: sign-off given for paid-tier fallback for next 30m if needed. prefer to avoid but customer impact is real.
junior-eng: rolling change to apply fallback header: `traffic-router apply --predicate 'queue>1500' --action rewrite-header 'x-fallback:compact'` - deployed to canary 10% then 100%.
oncall-sre: canary looks good. p95=1.4s, p99=3.2s, queue_depth=900.
incident-bot: update: state=mitigated; impact=partial; next_step=awaiting cloud quota approval and schedule postmortem.
customer-success: sending interim update to alpha-analytics and paybeam. they asked for ETA on full restoration.
infra-lead: cloud case updated: they provisioned temporary quota bump for 1 hour. initiating manual pool scale: `provisioner scale --pool hosted-us-west --add 12`.
oncall-sre: new instances booting. verifying kube nodes and model-serving pods. observed smoother drain; no errors on create now.
platform-pm: summary for night handoff: cause=marketing traffic spike + cloud quota exhaustion + autoscaler unable to recover; mitigations=rate-limits, low-priority evictions, fallback routing, manual scale after quota bump; customer_impact=intermittent 504s & high p99 for ~18m; followups=postmortem, autoscaler retry/backoff tuning, emergency quota runbook update.
oncall-sre: handing off to night oncall @infra-lead. please monitor queue until fully back to baseline (<200).
infra-lead: acknowledged. will continue monitoring and file postmortem draft in #postmortems tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
